title: New quinazolone–sulfonate conjugates with an acetohydrazide linker as potential antimicrobial agents: design, synthesis and molecular docking simulations
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1033-1048
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07563C, Paper

A new series of quinazolinone–alkanesulfonates have been designed and synthesized as antimicrobial agents. Two derivatives exhibited potential MIC activity.
